positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Distributed Systems · Neo4j · GitFlow · Large Language Models (LLM) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Kotlin · Helm (Software) · Kubernetes · Kafka Streams · Grafana · Microsoft Azure · Microservices · Prometheus.io

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected a cross-platform responsive, intuitive web interface with Flutter using strongly typed programming language Dart, allowing clients to freely view available services, book events and instantaneously receive cost estimate
• Integrated serverless architecture using Google Firebase that comes with analytics, authentication and non-relational, real-time database, thus allowing for engineering resource to focus on scaling and operation
• Implement Google Oauth to authenticate registered users or sign up new customers securely and reliably with ease 
• Architected Qt5 cross-platform desktop application which allows monitoring changes in selected directories and automatically compresses and uploads media files  to Google Photo
Developed Snapchat-like filters using OpenCV  face detection and face tracking algorithms, thus enhancing the user experience by adding augmented funny, entertaining filters on their faces in real-time
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Microservices

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Leveraged Node/Express server to handle high user load via an event-driven, non-blocking paradigm with middleware to handle data between client and server while executing asynchronous tasks against a non-relational database
• Implemented Apollo Server to prevent under- and over-fetching of data, and improve performance by minimizing the number of endpoints used to manage each user’s public and private projects 
• Integrated GraphQL resolvers with existing database to implement community platform for registered users, allowing seamless publishing and sharing projects between developers
• Utilized Apollo Playground to develop APIs and validate queries, reducing potential bugs during front-end integration
• Employed Jest and Supertest testing suite for both unit and server testing to ensure the application’s integrity and functionality, validate expected outputs and expediting the integration of refactored code, minimize the debugging of new features, and package functionality for engineers 
• Product developed under tech accelerator OS Labs ( opensourcelabs.io )

positions.title: Battery Engineer
positions.description: • Developed scripts using Enerchron Test Execution Software to automate test execution and data collection for High Voltage battery validation, leveraged Matlab for processing data, analyzing key metrics and provided key improvement feedback

positions.title: Automation Engineer
positions.description:
• Leveraged Raspberry Pi, a Linux micro-computer, to develop test automation software for high voltage battery, doubling the daily production output and reducing vehicle post-build charging issue
• Implemented an application interface between a network of automotive controllers with custom user interface, using Python and CAN-USB
• Utilized  Flask server and Websocket to visualize test metrics, and provide means to  control and troubleshoot the system remotely which significantly reduces engineering resources and boosts production output

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description:
•	Investigate and troubleshoot various control systems for Audio/Video applications
•	Clearly comprehend issues and communicate troubleshoot instructions over the phone
•	Test and evaluate new software release and provide feedback for the developer
•	Cooperate with sales/ engineering/ product development to quickly resolve technical issues
•	Evaluate system requirement and commission enterprise asset management software
•	Work closely with the end users and network administrators to ensure smooth and pleasant     customer experience

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Perform reference design HW performance and functionality testing
•	Perform board testing in various environments (Heat oven, DSL Line noise emulator, RF  cage)
•	Investigate failure base on test results and worked with design engineer to rectify the issues 
•	Handle logistics, test results and deliver designs to customer and internal engineers

positions.title: Network Technician
positions.description:
•	Implement FFMPEG Codec for optimized video streaming 
•	Handle radio communication between ground station and UAV
•	Set up display of video stream and in-flight data for ground control

positions.title: Peer Mentor
positions.description: Provide guidance for new students on UCI campus. Keep track and support their transitions. Advise and help out when needed

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description: •	Work with a diverse group of students at the center, teaching mathematical concepts from algebra to calculus. Lead workshop to promote mathematical study skill and ease math anxiety

projects.title: HackSC
projects.description:
•	The goal of the project was to integrate Myo controller into the truck’s control system
•	Implement a program that maps recognizable patterns of the Myo to control of the truck
•	Encounter issues with the limited bandwidth of the local network as it was shared by many attendees
•	Create a workaround by using UDP and repackage command mapping into smaller JSON format
•	Successfully completed the project within the time limit and reliably control the truck
